	RPT_DB as string (),

	v_CntNewMember as integer (),

	v_fileExists as boolean (),

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		MEME_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEME_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEME_MID_INIT as string,
		MEME_SEX as string,
		MEME_BIRTH_DT as timestamp,
		MEPE_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		MEPE_TERM_DT as timestamp,
		SGSG_MCTR_TYPE as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		MEPE_ELIG_IND as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		MEME_WRK_PHONE as string,
		LOADDATE as string,
		MaxEligRow as long,
		ExitInFile as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  		SBSB_ID,  	MEME_LAST_NAME,  	MEME_FIRST_NAME,  	MEME_MID_INIT,  	MEME_SEX,  	MEME_BIRTH_DT,  	MEPE_EFF_DT,  	MEPE_TERM_DT,  	SGSG_MCTR_TYPE,  	PDPD_ID,  	LTRIM(RTRIM(MEPE_ELIG_IND)) as MEPE_ELIG_IND,  	CSPI_ID, MEME_WRK_PHONE,  		\'No\' AS ExitInFile, 	MaxEligRow, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),101) AS LOADDATE 		FROM ( 		SELECT  		x.SBSB_ID, m.MEME_LAST_NAME, m.MEME_FIRST_NAME, m.MEME_MID_INIT, m.MEME_SEX, m.MEME_BIRTH_DT,  		me.MEPE_EFF_DT, me.MEPE_TERM_DT, sg.SGSG_MCTR_TYPE, me.PDPD_ID, me.MEPE_ELIG_IND,  		me.CSPI_ID, m.MEME_WRK_PHONE,  		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY x.SBSB_ID ORDER BY me.MEPE_EFF_DT DESC) AS MaxEligRow  		FROM APP_RPTS.CID_MEMBER_SUBSCRIBER_XWALK x 		JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER m WITH (NOLOCK) ON x.MEME_CK = m.MEME_CK 		JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG me WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.MEME_CK = me.MEME_CK 				JOIN APP_RPTS.CMC_SGSG_SUB_GROUP sg WITH (NOLOCK) ON me.SGSG_CK = sg.SGSG_CK 						WHERE me.GRGR_CK = 13 	) x 	 	WHERE MaxEligRow = 1--latest',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		SBSBID as string,
		HealthLinkStratID as string,
		Program as string,
		HealthLinkStratDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PHLStratyyyymmddfileload	source(output(
		SubscriberID as string,
		MemberID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  DISTINCT SubscriberID, MemberID  FROM member.Member',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource sort(asc(SBSB_ID, false)) ~> Sort1
PHLStratyyyymmddfileload,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(SBSBID == SubscriberID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sort(asc(SBSBID, false)) ~> Sort
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> NewMemberCountAGGREGATE
Sort,Sort1 join(SBSBID == SBSB_ID,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
NewMemberCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> NewMemberCountCACHESINK
MergeJoin derive(SBSB_ID = SBSB_ID,
		MEME_LAST_NAME = MEME_LAST_NAME,
		MEME_FIRST_NAME = MEME_FIRST_NAME,
		MEME_MID_INIT = MEME_MID_INIT,
		MEME_SEX = MEME_SEX,
		MEME_BIRTH_DT = MEME_BIRTH_DT,
		MEPE_EFF_DT = MEPE_EFF_DT,
		MEPE_TERM_DT = MEPE_TERM_DT,
		SGSG_MCTR_TYPE = SGSG_MCTR_TYPE,
		PDPD_ID = PDPD_ID,
		MEPE_ELIG_IND = MEPE_ELIG_IND,
		CSPI_ID = CSPI_ID,
		MEME_WRK_PHONE = MEME_WRK_PHONE,
		LOADDATE = LOADDATE,
		ExitInFile = ExitInFile) ~> MergeJoinREFORMAT1
MergeJoinREFORMAT1 sink(input(
		MEME_WRK_PHONE as string,
		MEPE_TERM_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEME_FIRST_NAME as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		SGSG_MCTR_TYPE as string,
		MEPE_EFF_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ExitInFile as string,
		MEME_SEX as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		MEPE_ELIG_IND as string,
		MEME_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEME_BIRTH_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEME_MID_INIT as string,
		LOADDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CSPI_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MEME_WRK_PHONE,
		MEPE_TERM_DT,
		MEME_FIRST_NAME,
		SBSB_ID,
		SGSG_MCTR_TYPE,
		MEPE_EFF_DT,
		ExitInFile,
		MEME_SEX,
		PDPD_ID,
		MEPE_ELIG_IND,
		MEME_LAST_NAME,
		MEME_BIRTH_DT,
		MEME_MID_INIT,
		LOADDATE,
		CSPI_ID)) ~> APPDMCCUTNHEALTHLINKNONEXISTINGMEMBER
